event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Tech led a narrow, low-volume grind higher.
Sept NFP printed 2.9万 vs 9万 forecast and wages 0.1% vs 0.30%, a big miss that pushed Polymarket to 80% no-change for Oct 28 and left bond caution the only headwind. QQQ +0.88% to a record with NVDA strength, but 26% of S&P names above the 50-DMA says this is mega-cap, not breadth.

INDICES — VIX 15.5, below its 20-day (15.9).
QQQ +0.88%, SPY +0.67%, IWM +0.66%, RSP +0.66%, DIA +0.20%, SOXX +0.10%. Large > small by 0.22pp — no size rotation. Most notable cross-asset move: USO -2.29%; UUP +0.35%. SPY/QQQ above 200-DMA — no CTA trigger.

VOLUME & BREADTH — Volume is going to forgotten places.
SPY 1.0x and QQQ absent from the gainers (SOXX 0.6x) — index-level vol is average: low-conviction rally, not accumulation. XLRE 1.5x, XLU 1.3x, XLB 1.2x are seeing attention while XLE 0.8x and XLP 0.8x fade. Breadth diverges: 62% advancers and a 1.69 up/down volume ratio, but only 26% above the 50-DMA and 19 highs vs 46 lows — narrow, not broad.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLB Materials +1.31%, XLC Comms +1.17%, XLE Energy +1.00%, XLF Financials +0.73%, XLV Healthcare +0.72%, XLP Staples +0.63%, XLK Technology +0.56%, XLU Utilities +0.35%, XLY Discretionary +0.35%, XLI Industrials +0.09%, XLRE Real Estate -0.34%.
Top industries OIH +3.14% and KWEB +2.93%; bottom USO -2.29% and WGMI -2.18%. Flows: XLU +$1,813mm (100p) and XLC +$676mm (98p) in; XLF -$1,958mm (0p) and XLE -$829mm (4p) out — utilities inflows contradict their +0.35% price. Defensive bid, tech flows, but high-to-low rotation.

POSITIONING — QQQ PCR 1.64 vs SPY 0.33: Nasdaq protection bid against SPY complacency.
QQQ skew +7.2% and ATM IV 16.4% vs SPY 10.9%. SPY spot sits above its 780 gamma flip — dealers dampen, not amplify. VIXEQ 38.3 vs VIX 15.5 is a wide gap: high single-stock dispersion, rotation tape.

CROSS-ASSET — Dollar +0.35% with gold -0.16% and silver +0.71% — metals split despite the bid.
Oil -2.29% dragged USO and JETS -0.89% while OIH still gained 3.14%. Next FOMC Oct 28; Polymarket prices 80% no-change, hike 20% (-14pp in 5 days).

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 53.6, Neutral.
LEN -6.73% (22% YTD decline per feed), CEG +3.93%, ISRG +3.71%. MDT +1.84% on 3.1x volume — accumulation; VST +3.48% on 2.1x. Momentum: XLK +7.29% 20d best sector, XLRE -7.42% worst. Watch MDT (3.1x vol breakout), VST (2.1x, power complex), XLRE (1.5x volume into a -0.34% close — distribution).
